images.prompt: Create an original abstract background illustration for a professional Vietnamese office-suite Windows installer. Portrait canvas, 1024 x 1792 pixels, full bleed. Clean modern flat geometry with restrained soft gradients: a calm brand-blue #0072BB field, subtly deeper blue toward the bottom. Keep the upper 65 percent almost empty and evenly blue for a logo tile and white typography that will be composited later. In the bottom 35 percent, arrange a few elegant overlapping paper-like planes, a very subtle spreadsheet grid, and a small slide-like rectangle, integrated into flowing blue shapes. Use tiny restrained accents of Writer blue #2F4FC4, Sheets green #1E8E3E, and Slides orange #E8710A. Broad simple forms must remain clean when reduced to 162 x 312 pixels. Crisp shapes, smooth gradients, calm professional mood, no texture or grain, no shadows that look muddy. Absolutely no text, letters, words, numbers, typography, logos, brand marks, watermarks, people, faces, or product boxes. Do not draw any triangle logo or monogram.

Create an original abstract horizontal accent background for the right end of a professional Windows installer banner. Landscape canvas, 1536 x 512 pixels. Clean modern flat design with soft smooth gradients. Pure white at the left third, fading into extremely pale ice blue at the right. Two broad flowing blue paper-like waves skim only the lower-right edge; use brand blue #0072BB sparingly, keeping the upper-right area almost white so a blue logo can be pasted there later. Calm, restrained, spacious, crisp, suitable for reduction to an approximately 180 x 57 pixel strip. No border or bottom separator line. No texture, grain, hard shadows, text, letters, words, numbers, typography, logos, brand marks, monograms, watermarks, people, faces, or product boxes. Do not draw a logo.
